create_mmdataset_instance: create an MMDataset instance with meta, video, text, and align processors for multi-modal data
getitem_fetch_example: fetch a multi-modal training example by index using MMDataset getitem method
collater_batch_samples: batch multiple sample dictionaries into an OrderedDict using MMDataset collater method
print_example_debug: print a debug summary of one multi-modal example including decoded captions and tensor shapes
len_dataset_size: get the total number of samples in the MMDataset via its length method
